facts.value: European Studies at the University of Limerick is a broad and integrated world-class programme that allows students an in-depth opportunity to study European languages and policy, equipping them with highly sought-after digital and research skills.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: It is the only European Studies programme in Ireland which includes Irish as one of its language options.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: Brexit means more direct interaction with the EU and with individual member states on the continent. A better knowledge of the European Union, and Ireland’s place within it, is more needed than ever before.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: An understanding of Europe requires knowledge of its historical origins, economic, legal, societal aspects, and political institutions.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

facts.value: The University of Limerick has long led the way in Ireland in this field, resulting in this degree being one of the longest established European Studies degree programmes in Europe.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

value: A healthy curiosity about how modern societies function
An interest in the European Union, and the issues facing the Union and its member states
A taste for languages other than your own
An interest in developing digital and research skills
An interest in working in teams and working independently
An ability to think independently and argue coherently for your ideas
